content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that builds one FUNWAVE coupling file per nested block. It loads a station/side map and infers the block count (L9-L10), scans side codes to locate each block's east/west/south/north station ranges (L35-L78), loads station time series and selects/coarsens a requested time window (L111-L133), spatially refines eta/u/v along each side with interp1 (L135-L155), plots coarse/fine checks (L157-L172), repacks each side as space-by-variable-by-time arrays (L177-L206), and writes a textual boundary header plus each time step through printside (L208-L245).

equations.ref: infer block count from final side code
last station row for each side and block
linear interpolation of elevation along a side

unresolved: `st_side_block` is assigned only when a matching side code is encountered (L43-L68), but every side/block element is unconditionally read to form `en_side_block` at L76 and to bound the station loop at L127. A missing side therefore produces use-before-assign (or an invalid stale matrix element) instead of an empty boundary.

`num_blocks` assumes the final row's third column is the maximum side code and exactly divisible by four (L10); the later length checks L24-L28 do not validate either assumption or the station-map ordering.

The time-window searches can return empty `start` or `stop` (L119-L120), after which L121 and L130-L132 index with empty bounds; even a one-sample result later makes `time(2)-time(1)` at L241 out of range.

`iscale` and `itscale` are checked only for vector length (L24-L28), not positive integer values. They are used as reciprocal spatial colon steps (L140,L152-L154) and temporal colon steps (L121,L130-L132), so zero, negative, or fractional values can create empty/misaligned sampling and output dimensions.
Neither `fopen` result is checked before writes (L80-L82 and L209-L224), so inaccessible log/output paths propagate invalid file identifiers into fprintf rather than a controlled failure.
`fcur` is defined at L7 but never used; the script reads and writes relative to `fgrid`/`foutput`, making the declared coupling-tools directory ineffective.
